blocks.heading: The log is a document
blocks.body:
Transformation view is not only a green bar. Open the **log**. Read the first unexpected line.

SUCCESS plus a missing image is a defect. SUCCESS plus an INFO about a default parameter is noise.

Start. First interesting WARN. Finish. That is the note. The rest waits.

lessons.title: Three lines from a SUCCESS log

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Three lines from a SUCCESS log.

This lab can fail. Fail when: The excerpt has no SUCCESS line, or you ignored a missing-file WARN, or you pasted the entire log.

Expected: Three-line excerpt. Ignore / never-ignore sentence. Real WARNs fixed or explained.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Three lines from a SUCCESS log.
blocks.intro: How to Three lines from a SUCCESS log. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Three lines from a SUCCESS log
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Rerun the site recipe or the PDF recipe so you have a fresh log in Transformation view.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Open the log (the view usually has a log document or console :  verify).

image.alt: Author mode button on the Oxygen editor tab
image.caption: Author is the word-processor view. The button sits on the file tab.
image.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Copy into oxygen-bootcamp-work/week6/success-log-excerpt.txt: (1) the command or recipe name, (2) one WARN or INFO that is not fatal, (3) the BUILD SUCCESSFUL / SUCCESS line.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: If there is a WARN about a missing image or a broken name, that is not SUCCESS in spirit :  go fix it. Do not write around a real miss.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Write one line: I will ignore ____ (example: a default-parameter INFO) and I will never ignore ____ (FAILED, missing file, broken name).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Do not paste a 4000-line log into the field note.

blocks.summary: Three-line excerpt. Ignore / never-ignore sentence. Real WARNs fixed or explained.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: BUILD SUCCESSFUL with a WARN: missing image. Ship it?
options: No :  treat a missing image as a defect; completeness should have caught it too
Yes if the PDF has enough pages
blocks.why: The engine can succeed and still omit a figure. Completeness plus the log together.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: HTML looks empty but the log says SUCCESS. First place you look?
options: The output folder path you configured (did you open an old out/?)
blocks.why: Wrong folder is the classic ‘success but empty’ bug.
